profile.headline: Senior Web Developer
profile.summary:
I'm a Web Developer and Designer working remotely from Newport, Rhode Island. I'm very passionate about web development and good user experience. I am available for freelance projects upon request.

My goals include working more with mobile interfaces and developing my knowledge of backend web development. I would also like to further my knowledge of JavaScript and React.

Specialties: icon design, GUI design, illustration, logo design/branding, customer service, front end development of websites, CSS, HTML, Javascript, PHP, git, svn, JSON

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:

-Intergrated various tools for GDPR compliance
